_doc: Shared alignment fixture for the golden cross-check: run through BOTH align.mjs (via align.dump.mjs) and trace_studio.model.segments (tools/test_trace_studio_segments.py); the normalized projections must be identical. A town-map-style trace whose recorded (retail) order waits CONV_POSE_START BEFORE LOADING_END, with an input + pins in the final segment; the port fired LOADING_END before CONV_POSE_START (the divergence).
